body.content: Counterfactual: if the acceptance record had not been read by the models proposing mutations, the mutation set would have been less targeted. The 3-of-26 result might have been 10-of-26 or 0-of-26. The entire distribution is conditional on the mutation-proposal process, not on the tests themselves.
body.unfinished: Would need access to the mutation-proposal prompts to test this.
body.why_keep_this: Makes the confound explicit as a counterfactual.
